## 🔧 Quick Command Reference

### Build
```bash
mvn clean install
```

### Run
```bash
mvn spring-boot:run
```

### Package
```bash
mvn clean package
```

### Docker
```bash
docker-compose up -d
```

### Test
```bash
bash test-endpoints.sh
```
